description: Figure 2 is a vertical bar chart illustrating average accuracy across 11 datasets for different training methods. The horizontal axis contains the categorical training-method labels, shown left to right as “Standard,” “Self-RAG,” “FactTune,” “CInGS (w/),” and “CInGS,” and the vertical axis is labeled “Avg. accuracy” with a linear numeric scale marked from 0 up to 60 in regular 10-unit tick intervals. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar: “Standard” is orange at approximately 52, “Self-RAG” is a light yellow/khaki bar at approximately 53, “FactTune” is light green at approximately 51, “CInGS (w/)” is medium blue at approximately 53, and “CInGS” is dark blue at approximately 58. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond the single series, there is no legend, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the distinct bar colors.
